name: SLAVES TO DARKNESS: OATH FULFILLED
description:
A Darkoath Warqueen has proven herself the rightful ruler of her barbarian tribesfolk time and again. She has sworn dread pacts to bring carnage to the Mortal Realms, and all who stand in her way must face both her wrath and that of her devoted warriors.

Take a Moment to Savour Victory

Celebrate Warhammer Day 2026 with this Commemorative Series miniature. The multipart plastic kit builds a Darkoath Warqueen to lead Slaves to Darkness armies in your games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. This fierce warrior is sculpted as though taking a moment to gaze over the battlefield after a hard-won battle, surveying the destruction unleashed by the brutal warriors under her command.

Her battle scars and battered wargear are a testament to years of service on the front lines, and her armour and leathers are decorated with trinkets, trophies, and talismans. If you're looking for a Darkoath leader to get stuck in on the front lines, her axe and shield are at your command. This striking sculpt also makes for a fantastic painting project for your display shelves, exuding a brooding malice that commands your best work.

Contents:
– 9 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 32mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Warhammer Colour Tool Set
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
– Warhammer Pro Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Tone Pro paints

This Commemorative Series miniature is only available while stocks last.
